about: Edges marked by hand on the rectified bolo-top photograph (rectify.py at 12 pixels to the millimetre), read off crops with a millimetre scale at 26.7 crop pixels to the millimetre: so in board millimetres, to about 0.1 mm, but still carrying the parallax of a part's top in a photograph from above. layout.py anchors them at a triangulated corner.
